summary.zh: 查看功能开关与投放规则
summary.en: Inspect feature flags and targeting rules

description.zh: 读取项目里的功能开关、目标规则与环境配置，可按需开关某个功能。适合确认某次发布是否受开关控制。连接时填入 LaunchDarkly 访问令牌。
description.en: Read feature flags, targeting rules, and per-environment settings, and toggle a flag when needed. Useful for confirming whether a release is gated. Supply a LaunchDarkly access token when connecting.

authHint.zh: 在 LaunchDarkly 账号设置里生成访问令牌后填入
authHint.en: Create an access token in your LaunchDarkly account settings
